rationale: Identification inverts exactly the defined three-obstacle jet matrix; a.e. invertibility is an explicit hypothesis.
from_statement: Author-derived conditional result, pending independent review: let a capacity-2 chordal Loewner driver be a continuous semimartingale dW=mu dt+dN, with N a continuous local martingale and d<N>=v dt, v>=0 and locally integrable coefficients. Fix constant alpha>0. Before three fixed obstacles are hit, let h_i be their hydrodynamic maps, analytic at W with positive derivative. If each h_i'(W)^alpha is a local martingale on a common positive interval and the matrix with rows (h_i''/h_i',h_i'''/h_i',(h_i''/h_i')^2) is invertible for a.e. time there, then mu=0 and v=8/3 a.e. there and alpha=5/8. Global Brownian-driver/SLE identification additionally needs such intervals to cover all finite times.
to_statement: For a capacity-2 chordal Loewner chain with real driver W and three obstacle-removal conformal maps h_i analytic near W with h_i'(W)>0, set u_i=h_i''(W)/h_i'(W) and c_i=h_i'''(W)/h_i'(W). The three-probe jet matrix J has row i equal to (u_i,c_i,u_i^2). This is algebraic independence of coefficient tests, not probabilistic independence of the obstacles.

rationale: The stability result uses the concrete three-vertical-slit instance of the defined matrix.
from_statement: At the three-slit initial jet matrix J=[[-1/2,-3/4,1/4],[1/2,-3/4,1/4],[-3/4,-9/16,9/16]], corresponding to slit locations/heights (1,1),(-1,1),(1,sqrt(3)), define normalized drift residuals e=J(mu,v/2-4/3,[1+v(alpha-1)]/2). If |e_i|<=epsilon, then |mu|<=2epsilon, |v-8/3|<=(52/9)epsilon and |1+v(alpha-1)|<=(40/3)epsilon. If v>=v_min>0, also |alpha-5/8|<=(31/(2v_min))epsilon. The inverse matrix norm in maximum absolute row sum is 20/3. These are fixed-configuration bounds, pending independent review, with no SAW residual estimate asserted.

rationale: The two-probe ambiguity supplies the explicit pointwise wrong coefficients detected by the third row in the stability configuration.
from_statement: For the two symmetric vertical-slit jet rows (-1/2,-3/4,1/4) and (1/2,-3/4,1/4), the coefficient values mu=0,v=14/3,alpha=29/14 give theta=(mu,v/2-4/3,[1+v(alpha-1)]/2)=(0,1,3) and zero initial drift residual in both rows. The third row (-3/4,-9/16,9/16) gives residual 9/8. This exact pointwise algebra does not assert that those wrong coefficients make the first two processes martingales throughout an interval. Independent review is pending.

rationale: The SAW route would use the conditional identification only after its stated derivative-power and driver assumptions are proved; the gap entry records that they remain open obligations.
from_statement: The P0003 ledger source, Grimmett arXiv:2205.07318 Question 2.2, concerns uniform n-step honeycomb SAW from the origin under suitable rescaling. A related all-length critical boundary-to-boundary chordal conjecture is Duminil-Copin–Smirnov arXiv:1007.0575 Section 4 Conjecture 1. The w399 three-probe route proves only auxiliary conditional Loewner coefficient identification. Its hardest unproved input is convergence of localized random-domain SAW tail partition martingales to three derivative powers with one common positive exponent. Driver/filtration regularity, global probe coverage, curve convergence and transfer to the fixed-n ensemble are also unproved. Current openness is UNKNOWN; no full scaling-limit proof or novelty is claimed.
